origins.section: Several Knapsacks Share the Items: One Binary per Item and Knapsack
Every Item Goes to Exactly One Agent, at a Size That Depends on the Agent
An Agent That May Not Take an Item Gets No Variable

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-pooled: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-pooled: the pooled model is a **relaxation** of the multiple knapsack: it allows every plan the bins allow, and more. Its optimum is a bound, not a plan.
recorded.prompt:q-gap-rows: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-rows: **tasks** $`i`$ (the projects), each of which must go to exactly one agent; a size $`a_{i,k}`$ and a cost $`c_{i,k}`$ that depend on the pair. ... $`\sum_{k \in K} x_{i,k} = 1`$ ... $`\sum_{i \in I} a_{i,k}\, x_{i,k} \le b_k`$
recorded.prompt:q-permits: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-permits: A crew that may not do a project gets no $`x_{i,k}`$ for it, so no row can ever assign it

recorded.prompt:q-pooled:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pooled:a: "The pooled row promises 410, and no packing into the five bins achieves it"
recorded.prompt:q-pooled:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pooled:b: "it allows every plan the bins allow, and more." It gives an upper bound (410 against 395), not a lower one.
recorded.prompt:q-pooled:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pooled:c: "Every packing into the bins obeys the pooled row"
recorded.prompt:q-gap-rows:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-rows:a: "every project of the plan **must** be done, so 'at most one crew' becomes 'exactly one'."
recorded.prompt:q-gap-rows:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-rows:c: "Each capacity row is a knapsack row over the tasks, with sizes that belong to that agent alone." The row needs h[i,k].
recorded.prompt:q-gap-rows:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-rows:d: "each of which must go to exactly one agent". At least 1 would allow two inspectors on one inspection.
recorded.prompt:q-permits:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-permits:a: The page's alternative is a row x = 0 "for each forbidden pair", which "gives the same plans with more variables and rows". A row for every job and every crew would forbid all assignments.
recorded.prompt:q-permits:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-permits:b: "Note what the switch does not touch: every crew keeps its capacity, because Coast and Plains may still do distribution and vegetation work"
recorded.prompt:q-permits:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-permits:d: "A binary per item is no longer enough, because the model must say *which* knapsack an item is in."
